label: Bible Study
prompt: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be _____ unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verse: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
note: Paul's job description for the Lord's servant — gentle, teachable, patient.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the _____; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verse: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
note: God's coming is as sure as the morning and as refreshing as rain — the sunrise always shows up.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared _____ and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
verse: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king's meat.
note: Ten days of vegetables and water, and Daniel's crew looked fairer and healthier than everyone eating the king's food.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of _____.
verse: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
note: After listing mercy, kindness and meekness to 'put on,' Paul names love as the bond that ties the outfit together.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD said, I have _____ according to thy word:
verse: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
note: Moses interceded after the spies' bad report, and God answered in seven words: 'I have pardoned according to thy word.'
